input.overview: Knock down the three qualifying drop targets to activate the upper moving Clown target, then hit it enough times to spell C-L-O-W-N and light Red Special. The four-target bank advances Orange Special. The Lion's Cage hole raises its value and awards the completed sequence, while the Somersault rotating target advances its lane values. Use the multiplier lane until Advance Multiplier is lit, then return there to raise Bonus X.
input.simpleOverview: Knock down the three qualifying drops to activate the moving Clown target, then hit it repeatedly to spell C-L-O-W-N and light Red Special. Complete the four-target bank for Orange Special. Use the Lion's Cage hole for its growing award, and repeat the multiplier lane to raise Bonus X.
input.summary: Knock down the three qualifying drops, then keep hitting the moving Clown target until C-L-O-W-N is complete. Use the four-target bank for Orange Special, or move to Lion's Cage and Bonus X when those routes are safer.

steps.text: Knock down the three qualifying drop targets to activate the moving Clown target.
Hit the moving target repeatedly to spell C-L-O-W-N; completion lights Red Special at that target.
Complete the four-target bank to advance Orange Special, then hit the moving target when Orange Special is lit.
Repeat the multiplier lane; once Advance Multiplier is lit, another pass raises Bonus X.

alternatives.title: Build Lion's Cage
alternatives.when: Use this when the moving target or target banks are not safe.

steps.text: Shoot the Lion's Cage hole to advance its lit value.
Return when the final lamp is lit to collect the completed Lion's Cage award.
Finish C-L-O-W-N or the four-target Orange sequence before switching routes.
Take the lit moving-target collect, then rebuild from the safer bank.

machineSetup: Check the Red and Orange Special difficulty settings, Lion's Cage award, and configured Special values.
Test both drop-target groups, the moving Clown target, Lion's Cage hole, Somersault rotating target, multiplier lane, and all sequence lamps.
